definition: A Trace assigns a Boolean match to each natural-number episode. Recorded f n says every episode strictly before n matched. n is outside the record. delayedFailure matches every prior episode and fails at n. These mathematical alternatives establish deductive underdetermination, not metaphysical possibility or equiprobability.
